boundary.description: From the point where Broadhead Road crosses Twitchels Brook, S along Blackburn – Rossendale District boundary, Blackburn - Bury District boundary and Bolton - Bury District boundary to and NW along Arthur Lane, Stitch-Mi-Lane, New Lane, Blair Lane and Thicketford Road. Then N along Crompton Way (A58) to intersection with railway line at Hall-i-th-Wood and N along the railway line to its crossing with Oaks Lane and then W along Oaks Lane to the River Croal and N along the River Croal to Eagley Brook. NW by Eagley Brook, Eagley Way, Blackburn Road (A666), Eagley Brook, Dewhurst Clough, Delph Brook and by Blackburn – Bolton District boundary to Blackburn Road (A666). N by Blackburn Road to Cadshaw Brook and along northern boundary of North Turton civil parish to the crossing of Broadhead Road and Twitchels Brook.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St Brendan and St John Evangelist
internalBoundaries.description: From the confluence of River Croal and Eagley Brook, N to and E along Darwen Road, Turton Road and Printers Lane. Then N along Bradshaw Brook, across Jumbles Reservoir to and N along Blackburn – Bolton District boundary to the point it meets Bury boundary.
